description.value: Bulk Barn is Canada's largest bulk food retailer, selling hundreds of products — nuts, dried fruit, grains, pasta, spices, baking ingredients, and candy — by weight so customers buy exactly what they need. This Victoria location (store #661) is part of a national chain with over 300 stores. For a touring cyclist it is a practical resupply stop for calorie-dense trail staples like nuts, dried fruit, and granola purchased in precisely the quantities needed.
